sloka: वन वासाय रामस्य पन्च रात्रः अद्य गण्यते ।यः शोक हत हर्षायाः पन्च वर्ष उपमः मम ॥२-६२-१८॥
transliteration: vana vāsāya rāmasya panca rātraḥ adya gaṇyate ।yaḥ śoka hata harṣāyāḥ panca varṣa upamaḥ mama ॥2-62-18॥

translations.english: This is the fifth night of Rama's exile, but it is like five years to me whose joy has been destroyed by sorrow.
